holds.candidate: Energy North Project Ares, Murranji Station, Northern Territory
holds.reason: Federal referral 2026/10560 identifies a proposed 1 GW IT campus but its mapped project covers the energy development and data centre together. The NT EPA describes a 19,150 ha preliminary disturbance footprint within a 186,000 ha project. Check federal attachment 1, figure 2 or the NT EPA referral report for a separately licensed or independently registered data-centre location. The station or referral-area centroid cannot locate the campus.

holds.candidate: Gingerah Energy Project Meridien, Shire of Broome, Western Australia
holds.reason: Federal referral 2026/10654 covers a 27,520 ha renewable energy and data-centre project. Its attachment 1-1, figure 4, separately shades the proposed data centre. Gingerah Energy’s conceptual drawing uses third-party basemap imagery, and an open licence for its data-centre geometry has not been established. Obtain a licensed developer or government data-centre component, or independently published facility-level coordinates.

holds.candidate: CleanSpark Ripley former FAIST facility, 50 Walker East Drive, Tennessee
holds.reason: The Ripley mayor confirmed the completed sale and intended indoor bitcoin-mining use on July 6. The Tennessee Comptroller records CleanSpark Ripley 1 LLC as owner of the former FAIST parcel. The CEO acknowledged capacity in Ripley on August 6. The November 3 mining-technician posting names the city but does not identify the purchased building, disclose completion of the purchase, or report work or operations there. The city enacted a one-year development moratorium on August 3 without distinguishing this previously acquired building from the contemplated 130-acre expansion in its enactment minutes. A post-August site-specific project statement is needed.
holds.geometry_review: Cadastral parcel 049095 02300 at 50 Walker East Drive matches the FAIST address in the county directory. No locator has been admitted.
